title: C. elegans Extraction Protocol for LC-MS Analysis
author: Brianna M Garcia
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bahjib4n
materials: Fisher Scientific Isotemp High Speed Shaker

steps.title: Add beads to sample tubes
steps.instruction: Add 2.0 mm zirconium oxide beads and approximately 75 µL of 0.5 mm glass beads to each sample tube.

steps.title: Homogenize samples
steps.instruction: Place tubes in adapter trays chilled at –80 °C, load into a Tissuelyser II and homogenize at 1800 rpm for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Extract with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL of 100 % isopropanol to each 1.5 mL Eppendorf containing the homogenized sample, vortex lightly to suspend, then transfer the slurry to a fresh 2.0 mL Eppendorf, leaving the beads behind. Repeat the addition and transfer once more so that a total of 1.5 mL solvent is collected in the new tube.

steps.title: Vortex and incubate
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube for 1 minute, then incubate the tube at –20 °C overnight.

steps.title: Centrifuge first extract
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at maximum speed (22 100 g) for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Collect RP supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new 2.0 mL Eppendorf labeled for reverse‑phase (RP) chromatography and dry using a Labconco CentriVap concentrator (approximately 4–5 hours) until completely dry.

steps.title: Second extraction with MeOH/H2O
steps.instruction: Add 1.5 mL of 80 % methanol / 20 % water directly to the pellet remaining after the first centrifugation.

steps.title: Shake second extract
steps.instruction: Place tubes on a Fisher Scientific Isotemp High‑Speed Shaker at 1500 rpm for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge second extract
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the 2.0 mL Eppendorf tubes at maximum speed (22 100 g) for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Collect HILIC supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new 2.0 mL Eppendorf labeled for HILIC chromatography and dry using the Labconco CentriVap concentrator (approximately 4–5 hours) until completely dry.

steps.title: Dry remaining pellets
steps.instruction: Dry any remaining pellets for 1 hour, then store them at –80 °C.

steps.title: Store dried extracts
steps.instruction: Once completely dry, store the tubes at –80 °C until they are to be run on the LC‑MS instrument.

steps.title: Reconstitute samples
steps.instruction: For RP samples, add 75 µL of 100 % isopropanol; for HILIC samples, add 75 µL of 80 % methanol / 20 % water. Vortex briefly to mix.

steps.title: Transfer to LC‑MS vials
steps.instruction: Transfer the reconstituted solutions into appropriate LC‑MS vials.

steps.title: Store after LC‑MS
steps.instruction: After LC‑MS analysis, store the remaining sample material at –80 °C until ready for IMS analysis.
